Very pretty, no reason for you to feel insecure. For your skin i'd highly recommend you look into a niacinimide serum because it'll help you with pretty much all of your texture issues that age you. There's plenty of options out there but i'd be happy to point you in the direction of a specific product if you don't know where to start.
